# Split your tests into evenly timed CI shards

> Paste JUnit XML from pytest, Jest, Go, Maven/Gradle or RSpec and get an even split into N CI shards, the slowest-shard time, billed-minute savings, the best shard count, and ready-to-paste shard commands. Free, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
